title: Identify male patients diagnosed with SLE who have hemoglobin levels within
question: Identify male patients diagnosed with SLE who have hemoglobin levels within the normal range (10 < HGB < 17) and urea nitrogen levels at or above the upper limit of normal (UN >= 29). For each such patient, return their ID, sex, RF status (normal if RF < 20 and not NULL), and 'Normal' or 'Abnormal' to identify whether their total cholesterol is within the normal range (T-CHO < 250 and not NULL). Ensure each patient appears only once, and exclude any laboratory records where critical fields (HGB, UN, RF, T-CHO) are missing.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    p."XCL_058" AS ID,
    p."XCL_059" AS Sex,
    CASE WHEN p."XCL_063" = '-' THEN 'Normal' ELSE 'Abnormal' END AS RF_Status,
    CASE WHEN l."XCL_026" < 250 THEN 'Normal' ELSE 'Abnormal' END AS Cholesterol_Status
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p."XCL_058" = l."XCL_014"
JOIN Examination AS e ON p."XCL_058" = e."XCL_001"
WHERE p."XCL_059" = 'M'
  AND e."XCL_008" = 'SLE'
  AND l."XCL_032" > 10
  AND l."XCL_032" < 17
  AND l."XCL_049" >= 29
  AND l."XCL_032" IS NOT NULL
  AND l."XCL_049" IS NOT NULL
  AND p."XCL_063" IS NOT NULL
  AND l."XCL_026" IS NOT NULL

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT 
    T1."XCL_058" AS ID,
    T1."XCL_059" AS Sex,
    CASE 
        WHEN T3."XCL_018" < 20 THEN 'Normal' 
        ELSE 'Abnormal' 
    END AS RF_Status,
    CASE 
        WHEN T3."XCL_019" < 250 THEN 'Normal' 
        ELSE 'Abnormal' 
    END AS Cholesterol_Status
FROM 
    Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN 
    Examination AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN 
    Laboratory AS T3 ON T2."XCL_001" = T3."XCL_014"
WHERE 
    T1."XCL_059" = 'M'
    AND T2."XCL_008" = 'SLE'
    AND T3."XCL_016" > 10 
    AND T3."XCL_016" < 17
    AND T3."XCL_017" >= 29
    AND T3."XCL_018" IS NOT NULL
    AND T3."XCL_019" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    T1."XCL_058", 
    T1."XCL_059", 
    T3."XCL_018", 
    T3."XCL_019"
